entities.summary: James Andrew Himes is an American businessman and politician serving as the U.S. representative for Connecticut's 4th congressional district since 2009. Himes is a member of the Democratic Party. Jim Himes was a performers & entertainers from Lima (b. 1966-07-05, Lima). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
